title: Listening to the band at the Haydn Playhouse as a teenager
summary: At about 17 he listened to the band at the back door, with Bill Eastwood on banjo and Monk on drums.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Well I used to, when I moved out here, you see when I first moved out here I was 13 and when I got into music I was about 15 and I started to play. Then when I got to be about 17 I used to go to the Hayd Playhouse and used to do the band over there. Oh yeah? Yeah. Well you could walk over there. Yeah I could walk there, right by the halfway, where the Orkins place is up now. It used to be the Hayd Playhouse. I used to go over there and listen to the band over the back door. Bill Eastwood was playing banjo and Monk I think played drums back there too for a while. Yeah, sure. Monk was back there. And I forget who else was in the band because I used to talk to him and kind of play banjo. Yeah. I used to talk to him.
Yeah, well they had Mickey Marco and Charlie Cordella and all those guys.
Oh yeah, Cordella came back there.
